summary.text: Russ Muirhead is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 12 who has held the seat since December 2, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career includes work as an author and as a political science teacher at Dartmouth College.

paragraphs.text: Russell Muirhead, who is also known as Russ, lives in Hanover, New Hampshire, and graduated from Central High School.
His career experience includes working as an author and a political science teacher at Dartmouth College.
Muirhead was assigned to the House Election Law Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
